ranking_robustness_policy: Distinguish agreement under two scenarios from agreement under all three scenarios
normal_tissue_policy: Inspect all available HPA tissue profiles, preserving missingness and reliability information
limitations: Ranking scenarios are not independent experimental validation studies.
Agreement under correlated scenarios may overstate apparent rank stability.
HPA tissue-level maximum staining does not resolve all cell types.
Normal IHC evidence does not establish clinical toxicity or safety.
Bulk tumor enrichment does not identify malignant-cell expression.
Protein enrichment does not demonstrate antibody accessibility.
CRISPR dependency does not directly measure antibody efficacy.
No candidate has been experimentally validated.
